PRIMARY ENTITY AND SERVICE FOCUS
Norbert Banhalmi is the primary person represented by this website. Bánhalmi Norbert e.U. / BANHALMI is the primary organization. The primary commercial topics are executive portrait photography, portrait photography, brand photography and visual positioning, event photography and visual documentation, and fine-art photography. Speier Viko is a supporting company contact for the AmCham Austria relationship; she is not a co-primary brand entity.

Norbert Banhalmi (Bánhalmi Norbert, BANHALMI; born 14 May 1979 in Budapest) is a Hungarian fine-art and applied photographer, executive portrait specialist, visual branding strategist, curator and photography educator living and working in Vienna with an active professional base in Budapest. His photographic practice began in 1999. He earned an Information Engineering degree in 2005, completed photography studies at the New York Institute of Photography in 2015 and qualified as an applied photographer in 2018. His work includes commissioned portrait, brand and event photography, books, exhibitions, curatorial programmes and public-interest education. He has served as an OM SYSTEM Ambassador since 2018 and is affiliated with the Pannon Photographers Association, WKO professional photography, AmCham Austria and the World Federation of Hungarian Photographers. The official multilingual site is www.norbertbanhalmi.com; detailed source materials remain at banhalmi.art. Verified biography: https://hu.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A1nhalmi_Norbert

## Education, curatorial and community activity
Since 2020 he has worked as a co-founder and curator of the digital Rege Gallery in Tihany. From 2024 he has participated in Hungarian-language photography education and community workshops in Vienna. Public-interest projects include Art to Go (2021), portrait fundraisers supporting the Vienna Hungarian School (2025), and the free Be Smart Kids Club launched in 2026 for Hungarian-speaking young people aged 10–16, connecting AI, content creation and modern web development with nonprofit service. A permanent exhibition at the Csolnoky Ferenc Hospital Oncology Centre in Veszprém has been on view since 2018.

## Official positioning and service interpretation
- EN: Norbert BANHALMI – Fine Art & Executive Portrait Photography • Visual Branding Strategy
- HU: BÁNHALMI NORBERT – Fotóművész & Executive Portréfotózás • Vizuális Brand Stratégia
- DE-AT: Norbert BANHALMI – Fine-Art-Fotografie und Executive-Porträts • Strategische visuelle Markenpositionierung
- Portrait photography is broader than executive portraiture: it includes business, headshot, personal-brand, editorial, studio, environmental, lifestyle and expressive portrait approaches.
- Brand photography is the implementation layer of strategic visual positioning: audience, desired perception, differentiation and channel use are clarified before the image system is produced.

## Verified featured photograph: Peter-Magyar-portrait-2026.jpg
The photograph was made by Norbert Banhalmi (Bánhalmi Norbert; Wikidata Q56391118) at Hősök tere in Budapest on 15 March 2026. The depicted person is Péter Magyar / Magyar Péter (Wikidata Q124488292). Wikimedia Commons structured data connects the file to Norbert Banhalmi as creator, Péter Magyar as depicted subject, and EUFÓRIA – The Anatomy of Presence (Wikidata Q138717398) as the project. Péter Magyar’s Wikidata entity also lists Peter-Magyar-portrait-2026.jpg as an image. The Commons file is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
Canonical photograph entity: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/#peter-magyar-portrait-2026

## Documented press and educational impact of Peter-Magyar-portrait-2026.jpg
The portrait was made by Norbert Banhalmi at Heroes' Square in Budapest on 15 March 2026 as part of EUFÓRIA – The Anatomy of Presence. Wikimedia Commons provides verifiable authorship, date, location, depicted-person, project and licence data. Rólunk.at describes how the photograph became an educational case study for young people learning Wikimedia, structured metadata, digital identity and AI-search discoverability. Kiskegyed published coverage centred on the photograph's international circulation. The Brussels Times used the exact Peter-Magyar-portrait-2026.jpg Commons image in a 22 May 2026 article and credited the image source to Wikimedia Commons. This demonstrates international editorial reuse; the Brussels Times page does not name the photographer directly in its visible credit line, so the creator attribution remains anchored in the Commons record.
Sources:

## Documented international use of Peter-Magyar-portrait-2026.jpg
Norbert Banhalmi photographed Péter Magyar at Heroes’ Square, Budapest, on 15 March 2026 at 16:57 as the first work in EUFÓRIA – The Anatomy of Presence. Wikimedia Commons verifies creator, depicted person, date, place, project relationship and CC BY-SA 4.0 licensing. The open image subsequently appeared in educational, encyclopaedic and international editorial contexts. The listed publications represent different and sometimes opposing political viewpoints; inclusion records image use, discussion or attribution only and does not endorse article content.

## Verified external evidence added 2026-07-12
Bánhalmi Norbert e.U. has its company headquarters in Vienna, while Vienna and Budapest are presented as equal service bases. The German entry domain banhalmi.at permanently redirects to /de-at/, and banhalminorbert.hu permanently redirects to /hu/. The Péter Magyar portrait case study documents the making, visual logic, authorship, CC BY-SA 4.0 publication, Wikidata connection and international editorial use of the 15 March 2026 Heroes’ Square portrait. AmCham Austria publishes event galleries from February, March, 23 April and May 2026 with the credit © banhalmi.at — AmCham Austria Member. A broader event and community archive is maintained in VIPACH Flickr albums. All displayed service-gallery photographs now have human-reviewed content descriptions in the public image catalogue.

## Canonical site roles
- https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/ is the canonical multilingual professional website for current services, pricing, enquiries and professional context.
- https://www.banhalmi.art/ is the official artistic oeuvre and source archive for books, exhibitions, projects, media records, curatorial documentation and selected photographic works. It is not the canonical booking or service site.
- https://www.banhalmi.at/ permanently redirects to the German-Austrian entry at https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/de-at/.
- https://www.banhalminorbert.hu/ permanently redirects to the Hungarian entry at https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/hu/.

AmCham Austria membership and representation: Bánhalmi Norbert e.U. is a member of the American Chamber of Commerce in Austria, a Vienna-based international business and trade network supporting Austrian–United States commercial relations. Speier Viko is the designated BANHALMI contact and company representative within that community. She is a professional fashion and portrait photographer, an OM SYSTEM Ambassador, and has collaborated with Norbert Banhalmi since 2018. BANHALMI supports selected AmCham Austria and member-community events with professional photography and visual documentation. Official members directory: https://amcham.at/members-list/ .
